tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: Dubai areas covered, with data freshness and coverage level.

tools.name: get_area_snapshot
tools.description: Price and rent ranges from registered DLD deals and Ejari contracts, with sample sizes, 12-month forecast interval and our public backtest. Abstains when the sample is too small.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: Compares an asking price or rent against the fair range from real closed deals in the same segment.

tools.name: get_comparables
tools.description: Recent registered sales in the segment: date, price, size, type.

tools.name: estimate_rent
tools.description: Rent range from new Ejari contracts started in the last 12 months, with n.

tools.name: get_market_trend
tools.description: Quarterly sale and rent index for the area.

tools.name: get_broker_guides
tools.description: Broker-attributed facts about the area (author BRN, date, source), only those published with the broker's permission.

tools.name: start_brief
tools.description: Prepares a Brief Battle request: brokers in the area compete for 72 hours with real units, ranked against DLD fair value. Returns a link the buyer opens to confirm and submit; nothing is sent until the buyer confirms.
